closed_findings: The former cool-white secondary stone family is gone; coursed walls and dressed work now read as one warm aged limestone family.
Quoins, arches, strings, cornices, dormers, cupola columns, crest carrier and supports, jambs, reveals and sills retain only bounded dressed-versus-coursed value variation.
Slate, oak, copper, iron and glass remain correctly distinct.
Left, right, rear and rear-side cameras contain the complete grade-to-finial envelope and visible footprint with neutral margin.
No regression remains in the other mandatory views.
